Prove the following statement for every nondegenerate configuration satisfying the assumptions. Give a self-contained proof and justify the ordering, branch, and sign conditions that the argument uses. Do not substitute a numerical example for a proof. Write the proof in English.

Two circles tangent to line AB at distinct points A and B meet at distinct points M and N on the same side of AB, with M closer to AB than N. Assume triangle NAB is acute and scalene. Let O be the midpoint of AB. Through M draw the line parallel to AB; let it meet the first circle again at C and the second circle again at D. Set E=AC∩BD, P=AN∩CD, and Q=BN∩CD. Let F be the perpendicular foot from M to AB. Prove that the area of triangle EPQ is AB·MF·(1 − AB²/(4·ON²)).
